MOVEMENT AND CREATIVE ACTIVITIES — MOCK EXAM #19
====

GRADE: Grade 2
SUBJECT: MOVEMENT AND CREATIVE ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Remove the need for rules
   B. Guarantee a trophy
   C. Replace drinking water
   D. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk

2. Best practice when working on Musical Instruments: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Musical Instruments.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Musical Instruments.
   C. Practise Musical Instruments with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Damage equipment used for Musical Instruments.

3. Best practice when working on Singing games: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Singing games.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Singing games.
   C. Damage equipment used for Singing games.
   D. Practise Singing games with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

4. Best practice when working on Songs PERFORMING: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Songs PERFORMING with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Songs PERFORMING.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Songs PERFORMING.
   D. Damage equipment used for Songs PERFORMING.

5. Best practice when working on Elements of AND RESPONDING: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Elements of AND RESPONDING.
   B. Practise Elements of AND RESPONDING with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Damage equipment used for Elements of AND RESPONDING.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Elements of AND RESPONDING.

6. Best practice when working on Rhythm COMPOSING: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Rhythm COMPOSING.
   B. Practise Rhythm COMPOSING with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Rhythm COMPOSING.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Rhythm COMPOSING.

7. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Green, orange, and purple
   B. Black, white, and grey
   C. Brown, pink, and gold
   D. Red, blue, and yellow

8. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. The speed of the music
   B. Only the volume
   C. Only the costume
   D. The ticket price

9. Best practice when working on Melody: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Melody.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Melody.
   C. Practise Melody with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Melody.

10. Best practice when working on Dance: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Dance.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Dance.
   C. Damage equipment used for Dance.
   D. Practise Dance with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
11. In three clear sentences, explain Elements of AND RESPONDING and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

12. In three clear sentences, explain Songs PERFORMING and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Melody and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Elements of AND RESPONDING and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
